title: Sharon AI to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: NEW YORK - September 8, 2026 – SharonAI Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: SHAZ) ("Sharon AI" or the "Company"), a leading Australian Neocloud delivering trusted AI
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK – September 8, 2026** – SharonAI Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: SHAZ) (“Sharon AI” or the “Company”), a leading Australian Neocloud delivering trusted AI infrastructure, today announced that members of its management team will be participating in the following investor conferences in September:


- Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference, San Francisco, CA on September 8
- Citi 2026 Global TMT Conference, New York, NY on September 10
- CLSA 33rd Investors Forum, Hong Kong, September 23-24
- 2026 RBC Capital Markets Global Communications Infrastructure Conference, Chicago, IL on September 29-30


For more information, please reach out to your conference representative.


**About Sharon AI**


Sharon AI (NASDAQ: SHAZ) is a leading Australian Neocloud delivering trusted sovereign AI infrastructure. Through its AI Factory platform and world-class ecosystem of technology and co-location partners, Sharon AI expands access to the scalable capabilities that organisations need to build, train and run AI, from model training through to inference and agentic AI. Serving customers globally, Sharon AI helps organisations move faster from AI potential to measurable value. For more information, visit[www.sharonai.com](https://sharonai.com/) .
